title: Scaffold the Next.js application and its production launch command
statement: Create the application under `app/` with `@next/mdx` configured, and a documented command that runs `next build` followed by `next start` on loopback. No views yet beyond a route that responds. The remark plugin is referenced by ABSOLUTE module path because Turbopack serialises the config and `@next/mdx` resolves a relative path from its own package directory.
notes: First because everything else needs somewhere to live. ⚠️ Production mode only (DEC-0018): `next dev` is a contributor workflow and never a shipped configuration, so the launch command must not offer it as an option.
